ports.titleUnknown: Port {port} is in use by another program

drift.title: Config file changed outside Forgebox: {path}
drift.cause: The file differs from what Forgebox rendered in the last 24 hours. Edits outside the managed blocks are kept; edits inside them are overwritten.

caUntrusted.cause: Browsers warn about every HTTPS site until the Forgebox CA is trusted.

caExpiring.cause: Certificates issued by it stop working after that date; rotate the CA before then.

certs.title_other: {count} certificates expire in less than 30 days
certs.cause: The first one is {host} ({days} days left). Renewing issues a new certificate with the same names.
certs.causeExpired: The first one is {host} and has already expired. Renewing issues a new certificate with the same names.

cause.resolver_not_on_port53: The Forgebox resolver is not on port 53 and NRPT cannot name a port.
cause.none: Nothing routes the local TLD to the Forgebox resolver.
cause.hosts: Names are written to the hosts file instead of being resolved by Forgebox.

failed.title: {name} failed
